descriptions.preferred: 它是原产于太平洋西北地区的藤槭，而 'Fire' 指的是这种枫树火红的树皮。太平洋之火的树皮比珊瑚阁的还要亮。春天新叶是嫩黄色的，夏季反绿，在秋天，叶子主要是明亮的黄色，中间夹杂着橙色和红色，而其鲜红色的树皮将变得更加浓烈。它的叶子是 7-9 裂，成年高度大约 3 米，适合种植在 5-9 区，该品种需要及时遮阴。

rhs.description: Deciduous, upright, then spreading, multi-stemmed shrub about 2m in height, with brilliant red young stems, and 7-9 lobed leaves. The young growth is orange with red veins, maturing to green in summer then golden-yellow in autumn, with orange tints if grown in full sun. Decorative purple and white flowers in spring

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants, Flower borders and beds

care.cultivation: Grow in fertile, moist but well-drained soil in sun or partial shade in a sheltered position. Suitable for dry, shady situations but best autumn leaf colour in full sun. See tree cultivation for further advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings in early summer

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、多干灌木，株形先直立后开展，高约 2 米；幼枝鲜红醒目，叶片 7 至 9 裂。新梢叶为橙色并带红色叶脉，夏季成熟后转绿，秋季变为金黄色；若在全日照下栽培，常会带橙色色调。春季开具观赏性的紫白色花。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于肥沃、湿润但排水良好的土壤中，种植于避风的向阳或半阴位置。可耐较干燥的荫蔽环境，但在全日照条件下秋叶色表现最佳。更多建议参见 tree cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有需要，仅可在深秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或于初夏进行软枝扦插繁殖。
